cause.label: management_or_governance
cause.what_happened: At 08:30 ET on 2026-10-06, Auddia cancelled the adjourned 10-07 special meeting on its merger with Thramann Holdings, which would form McCarthy Finney. 89% of votes cast were in favour, but the yes votes did not reach a majority of shares outstanding. The vote will be held again under a new record date that has not been set. The stock fell 13.5% on 10-06 and is down a further 8.3% today on 0.75x normal volume, with no new filing today (EDGAR atom feed checked at 15:10 ET).

findings.finding: Auddia's 10-06 release committed to a 'CEO Letter to Shareholders later this week' covering 2026 progress, LT350 distributed-datacenter developments and AI-infrastructure strategy. Both of the company's recent releases went out at 08:30 ET, so a Thursday 10-08 letter would land before the open, inside the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The company dated it itself: 'later this week' from Tuesday 10-06 means 10-07 to 10-09. No such filing was on EDGAR at 15:10 ET 10-07, so the letter has yet to land. Thursday 10-08 pre-market is one of two remaining likely slots; the other is Friday, which falls outside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The company's merger-process releases have been followed by falls: 10-06 at -13.5% (and -8.3% today), and the 09-24 adjournment came just before the 09-25 drop of -10.9%, which rebounded +6.1% the next session. The baseline also records one +60.6% next-session spike after the 2026-08-07 fall. This is a retail microcap with an ATR of 18.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The close holds the cancellation, not the letter. The letter is management's promotional case for the AI-datacenter pivot, and its stated purpose is to rebuild support for a re-vote. If the tape were already holding a positive letter, today's follow-through selling on below-normal volume would not be there. The size is cut roughly in half because the letter could just as easily land on Friday, outside the window.
findings.independence: The 425 filing of the same release says the same thing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1554818/000168316826007637/auddia_425.htm), so this is one company source, not two.

outside_window.finding: Merger closing condition requires at least $12.0m of Auddia net cash. Cash was $9.56m at 2026-06-30 against a six-month operating burn of $4.78m, and the ATM is exhausted. A raise is therefore likely before any closing, and the White Lion $50m equity line (to 2027-12-31) can sell into any rally. Neither has a date.
outside_window.resolves_by: undated; before the rescheduled merger vote
